newsitem.title: UK: Iran tenders to buy more April white sugar - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iran tenders to buy more April white sugar - trade.

text.p: Iran's state-run Government Trading Corporation (GTC) tendered on Monday to buy a cargo of white sugar for shipment in April, London traders said.
No more details were immediately available.
Last week the GTC bought 30,000 tonnes of Cuban raw sugar for March/May shipment and 14,000 tonnes of European Union white sugar, again for April.
Prices paid were reported to be $269.00 per tonne for the raws and $313.00 for the whites, although one trader cited a price of $313.50.
